RAN#106 approved WI for Ambient IoT in [1]. One of the objectives for RAN2 is listed as follows: In RAN2#129 [2], the following agreements were made: To allow further discussion of the FFD items, RAN2#129 allocated an email discussion [3]: The report from this email discussion makes a number of proposals which were discussed during RAN2#129bis. Some proposals relating to the expected behaviour of the device when it receives a new service request while processing an earlier one are quoted below: During RAN2#129bis [4[, an offline discussion [5] was held to determine whether to choose from proposal 1: Option (a): Ignore all new requests and R2D messages addressed to itself but not associated with the ongoing procedure or: Option (b): Terminate the ongoing procedure and respond to the latest request No conclusion was reached and the decision was deferred to the present meeting. In this contribution we revisit the issue. A key issue is that there is no clear mechanism by which a device can determine that a service request has completed. If it is addressed by a new service request, that is, it receives a new service request with a valid address, is it safe for the device to assume that the current service request has been terminated and to follow the new service request?
